name: net-sleuth

scripts.test: rolldown tests/network.test.ts --platform node --format esm -o out/tests/network.test.mjs --log-level silent && rolldown tests/security.test.ts --platform node --format esm -o out/tests/security.test.mjs --log-level silent && rolldown tests/vault.test.ts --platform node --format esm -o out/tests/vault.test.mjs --log-level silent && rolldown tests/devices.test.ts --platform node --format esm -o out/tests/devices.test.mjs --log-level silent && rolldown tests/discovery.test.ts --platform node --format esm -o out/tests/discovery.test.mjs --log-level silent && rolldown tests/router.test.ts --platform node --format esm -o out/tests/router.test.mjs --log-level silent && node out/tests/network.test.mjs && node out/tests/security.test.mjs && node out/tests/vault.test.mjs && node out/tests/devices.test.mjs && node out/tests/discovery.test.mjs && node out/tests/router.test.mjs

author: net-sleuth
